descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S13 Pad state transitions (Tim's chromium tests): close/reopen, reload and typing alone; recording, Stop and the next box on the on-device test engine

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Quick Dictation opens from the Hospital home screen (patient list). The physician dictates or types into a box and adds a new box for the next patient, so one pad holds several boxes. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 step 1)
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)
  • U4 An unassigned box stays on the pad after Quick Dictation is closed and reopened, as the physician's own log. Boxes are never silently dropped. (The UAT says 'stays on the sheet'; … (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 5; TFA-92582 step 5; TFA-92583 AC 4)
  • U6 No auto-assignment anywhere: the app never splits one dictation across patients, never routes by name or room, and never merges boxes. There is no AI routing. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 2; TFA-92583 AC 2)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Tim's chromium tests on QUICK_DICTATION_USER (pad cleared before each test); the dictation tests set dictationEngine = ON_DEVICE_TEST_ENGINE with a speech-recognition mock

When Type 'Bed 415, telemetry likely artifact', close and reopen; type 'Bed 9, family updated by phone, no changes.', reload, reopen; type 'Room <patient room> doing well' and wait 2 s. Dictate into a box and try to place it while recording; Stop with last words still arriving; dictate into box 2 while box 1 is still going

Then Text still in the box after reopen and after reload, still unassigned; the patient whose room was typed has nothing on the chart. A box cannot be placed while words may still arrive; once all words are in, they all reach the chart; box 1 stops for good and each box keeps only its own words

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: textarea toHaveValue after reopen / reload, 'Assign to patient' visible (U4); encounterNotes not containing 'doing well' (U6); Assign and Link disabled while recording, enabled after Stop; encounterNotes toBe(phrase) (U2); drafts equal [first, second] with no cross-over (U6: no merge, no split). …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both (typing and reload legs) / local (ON_DEVICE_TEST_ENGINE dictation legs); Source: matrix (lane A).
